title: The Underwater Birthday Party
description: Celebrate a birthday at the bottom of the ocean

fields.prompt: What is the birthday kid's name?
What is a verb ending in -ing?
What would you yell when excited?

template:
For {name}'s {number}th birthday, there was only one place to have the party: the bottom of the ocean!

Everyone put on their {adj1} swim goggles and dove in. The first guest to arrive was a {seacreature} wearing a party hat on its {bodypart}. "Happy birthday!" it blubbed. Bubbles went everywhere.

The cake was a giant tower of {food}, and the candles were lit by an electric eel who was very proud of his job. When {name} blew them out, the whole ocean shouted, "{exclaim}"

Then came the games. First was Pin the Tail on the {seacreature}, which the {seacreature} did not enjoy at all. Next was a race, where everyone had to swim while {verbing}. A crab won, even though he was going sideways and also {verbing}.

A band of dolphins played music on instruments made of seashells. Every time they hit a high note, it went {noise}, and a school of fish fainted from the sound.

Finally, it was time for presents. {name} got a shiny {gift} from the {seacreature}, a thousand {pluralnoun} from the crabs, and a hug from a very squishy sea star.

"This is the best birthday ever," said {name}.

Then everyone sat in the sand, ate {food}, and floated home with full tummies, covered in glitter and happy bubbles.
